name: Drupal Forge Deployment
description: Prepare Drupal Forge launch URLs from backup and repository metadata.
project_description: Drupal Forge Deployment is an experimental (0.0.x pre-release) module that assembles a Drupal Forge "DrupalPod" launch URL from your existing site context. It inspects the local Git repository (via shell-out git commands) to find a supported GitHub or GitLab remote and its branches, discovers database backups stored in a Backup and Migrate AWS S3 destination, resolves a deployment container image from the running PHP version, and combines these into an https://www.drupalforge.org/drupalpod/new# fragment URL with DP_REPO_BRANCH, DP_IMAGE and S3/AWS environment parameters. The admin UI is a single four-step readiness wizard at /admin/config/development/drupalforge-deploy, gated by the module's own 'administer drupalforge deploy' permission. It hard-depends on backup_migrate_aws_s3 (which in turn requires backup_migrate) and requires a public GitHub or GitLab remote; private repositories are not yet supported.
